quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on his jersey number history and legacy
quotes.excerpt: Seven is the sign of completion. I'm here.

text_blocks.speaker: Rudy Gay
text_blocks.text: I started with 22. 22 was my number. But the number of a wing back in Baltimore, so I'm like, oh, this is, I'm wearing 22. And when I got to the Cuse, 22 was retired. So you were 15. Dave Bing. I'm calling Dave Bing like, I'm trying to get the number. I'm trying to get, I'm trying to get Deuce Deuce. I'm trying to pull the jersey.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: We not letting you get this down. We not letting you get this down. Put it out the Raptors.

text_blocks.speaker: Rudy Gay
text_blocks.text: And it was like three numbers left, like 25, 15, and some other shit. And I just, I just grabbed 15. I didn't know what I was grabbing.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: So you went back to the pros, and when you got to the pros, you went to 15. And then everything, the whole brand of 15 started. Then we got a new colorway in Denver. That nugget blue with the gold. So I'm like, 15 was, it was alive. When I came to New York, the story was like, all right, I'm coming back. I'm coming back home. Like, this is, this is, you know, seven is, seven is the sign of completion. Like, I'm here.
